text: むずかしそうな　もじや　すうじ　ばかりで　ちんぷんかんぷん！？

structure.jp: むずかしそうな　もじや　すうじ

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そう after an adjective stem says it looks that way. むずかしそうな = 'difficult-looking'.

patterns.name: 〜ばかり
patterns.explanation: ばかり means nothing but; で links to the next part. もじや　すうじ　ばかりで = 'it's just letters and numbers, so'.
